app.name: Lone Lookout
app.short_description: A quiet season in a fire lookout
app.long_description:
A quiet first-person exploration game. Spend the end of a fire season as the lookout on Kestrel Knob in the Ashen Peaks: walk, look, listen, sit, and talk on the radio with Dot at Basin Station. No combat, no timers, no fail states.
Phase 2 prototype: a small test area around the tower, pointer look, Nunchuk walking, the Day 1 radio check, a note to read and a log to sit on.
Controls: Nunchuk stick to walk (Z to stride), point to look, A to interact, B for the radio, HOME to exit.
